title.help: The name of the process under review.

roles.help: The participating roles, the rows of the matrix: people, departments or systems that take part in the process. Every step card shows each role as a selectable button.

id.help: The identifier of the role; value for roleId and entry in the roleIds of the steps.

label.help: The name of the role as shown at the start of its matrix row; empty, the matrix shows a placeholder.

steps.help: The process steps in flow order, the columns of the matrix. Each step has a card below with activity, roles, times, waste and notes.

id.help: The identifier of the step; value for stepId.

title.help: The title of the step in the matrix column header and on the card; empty, the card shows its number S1, S2 …

description.help: What happens in this step: the activity in your own words.

roleIds.help: The identifiers of the roles that take part in this step; a filled dot in the matrix.

processTime.help: The processing time: how long the case is actually worked on. The duration is a number with a unit, such as 4h 30min, 1d or 45min, and adds to the processing total. Leaving the field brings a readable entry into its normal form; an unreadable one stays, is marked red and does not count.

waitTime.help: The waiting time: how long the case lies idle between activities, in the inbox, on file, in a queue. The duration is a number with a unit, such as 2d or 3h, and adds to the waiting total. An unreadable entry stays, is marked red and does not count.

mudaIds.help: The identifiers of the waste categories that mark this step.

notes.help: Free notes on the step: observations, hand-offs, bottlenecks.

mudaCategories.help: The waste categories (Muda) that can mark a step. The eight classic types of TIMWOODS+S are preset; you can rename, recolour, add or remove them. At least one category always remains.

id.help: The identifier of the waste category; value for mudaId and entry in the mudaIds of the steps.

code.help: The short code of the waste category, at most four characters; it appears on the step card button before the name.

labelKey.help: For a preset category the key of its translated name; it applies as long as no own name is set. Own categories have none.

label.help: An own name for the waste category. Left empty, a preset category keeps its translated name, shown as the placeholder.

color.help: The colour of the waste category; it marks the button on the step card when the category is set.

timeUnits.help: The time units recognised in the step durations, each with a short code and its length in seconds. By default a workday counts 8 hours. When a unit changes, all durations are read again. At least one unit always remains.

id.help: The identifier of the time unit; value for unitId.

label.help: The code of the unit as it follows the number in a duration, such as min or h; case does not matter.

factorSeconds.help: The length of the unit in seconds, a number greater than 0; an 8-hour workday is 28800 seconds.

collapsed.help: The identifiers of the collapsed step cards. The state is stored but does not change the content.

settingsOpen.help: Opens or closes the area with the waste categories and time units. The state is stored but does not change the data.

kpi.help: The KPIs as the bar below the matrix shows them: processing total, waiting total, lead time and process cycle efficiency, all times in seconds. Unreadable durations do not count.

invalidTimes.help: The durations that cannot be read with the time units, each with step and field; they are marked red on the card and count towards no KPI.

MakigamiKpi.process: The sum of all processing times: how long the case is actually worked on.
MakigamiKpi.wait: The sum of all waiting times: how long the case lies idle between activities.
MakigamiKpi.lead: The lead time: processing and waiting together, the total throughput time of the case.
MakigamiKpi.pce: The process cycle efficiency: the share of processing in the lead time. Without lead time there is no value.

TimeIssue.stepId: The identifier of the step with the unreadable duration.
TimeIssue.field: Which entry cannot be read: processTime (processing) or waitTime (waiting).

addRole.help: Adds a role without a name, as a new row at the bottom of the matrix.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no input and returns the identifier of the new role.

addStep.help: Adds a process step without a title at the end of the chain, as a new column on the right of the matrix.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no input and returns the identifier of the new step.

addMudaCategory.help: Adds a grey waste category without code and name.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no input and returns the identifier of the new category.

addTimeUnit.help: Adds a time unit without a code and a length of one second.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no input and returns the identifier of the new unit.

setParticipation.help: Decides whether a role takes part in a process step. On the step card each role is a button that a click marks or releases; in the matrix a click on the dot of role and step toggles the same.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.roleId: The identifier of the role as read() lists it under roles. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.participates: true makes the role take part, false removes its participation.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId, roleId and participates.

setMuda.help: Decides whether a waste category (Muda) marks a process step. On the step card each category is a button that a click sets or releases. The eight classic types (TIMWOODS+S) are preset; they can be adjusted in the settings.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.mudaId: The identifier of the waste category as read() lists it under mudaCategories. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.marked: true marks the step, false removes the mark.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId, mudaId and marked.

setRoleLabel.help: Sets the name of a role.

params.roleId: The identifier of the role as read() lists it under roles. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.label: The name of the role; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with roleId and label.

setStepTitle.help: Sets the title of a process step.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.text: The title of the step; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and text.

setStepDescription.help: Sets the description of the activity of a process step, i.e. what happens in it.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.text: The description of the activity; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and text.

setStepNotes.help: Sets the note of a process step, such as observations, hand-offs or bottlenecks.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.text: The note on the step; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and text.

setStepProcessTime.help: Sets the processing time of a process step — the time the case is worked on — and returns whether it is readable.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.text: The duration as text of number and unit, such as 30 min or 1 d 2 h; the recognised units are listed in timeUnits. An empty text clears it; an unreadable text is stored but does not count towards the KPIs, appears in invalidTimes and returns false.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and text.

setStepWaitTime.help: Sets the waiting time of a process step — the time the case lies idle — and returns whether it is readable.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.text: The duration as text of number and unit, such as 30 min or 1 d 2 h; the recognised units are listed in timeUnits. An empty text clears it; an unreadable text is stored but does not count towards the KPIs, appears in invalidTimes and returns false.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and text.

normalizeStepTime.help: Brings a readable duration of a step into its normal form, such as 90min into 1h 30min, as leaving the field does. An empty, unreadable or already normal entry stays unchanged.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and field.

setMudaCategory.help: Changes the given details of a waste category; all others stay. At least one detail is required.

params.mudaId: The identifier of the waste category as read() lists it under mudaCategories. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.code: The code of the category in the matrix and on the card; optional.
params.label: The own name of the category; an empty text keeps the preset one. Optional.
params.color: The colour as a hex value such as #4a90e2; optional.
params.command: The command as an object with mudaId and at least one of code, label, color.

setTimeUnit.help: Changes the given details of a time unit; all others stay. At least one detail is required. All durations are then read with the new units.

params.unitId: The identifier of the time unit as read() lists it under timeUnits. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.label: The code recognised in a duration; optional.
params.factorSeconds: The length of the unit in seconds, a number greater than 0; optional.
params.command: The command as an object with unitId and at least one of label, factorSeconds.

removeStep.help: Removes a process step together with its card. The interface asks first.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId.

removeRole.help: Removes a role together with its participation in all steps. The interface asks first.

params.roleId: The identifier of the role as read() lists it under roles. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with roleId.

removeMudaCategory.help: Removes a waste category together with its marks on all steps. The last category cannot be removed.

params.mudaId: The identifier of the waste category as read() lists it under mudaCategories. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with mudaId.

removeTimeUnit.help: Removes a time unit. Durations that use only this unit can no longer be read and do not count. The last unit cannot be removed.

params.unitId: The identifier of the time unit as read() lists it under timeUnits. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with unitId.

moveStep.help: Moves a process step to another position in the chain; the others close up. In the matrix you drag the grip in the column header, or focus the grip and press Alt+Arrow or Space, Arrow, Space.

params.stepId: The identifier of the process step as read() lists it under steps. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.to: The position the step takes afterwards, counted from 0; the last position is the number of steps minus 1. The same position changes nothing.
params.command: The command as an object with stepId and to.

moveRole.help: Moves a role to another position; the others close up. In the matrix you drag the grip at the start of the row, or focus the grip and press Alt+Arrow or Space, Arrow, Space.

params.roleId: The identifier of the role as read() lists it under roles. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.to: The position the role takes afterwards, counted from 0; the last position is the number of roles minus 1. The same position changes nothing.
params.command: The command as an object with roleId and to.

resetSettingsToDefaults.help: Restores the eight preset waste categories and the four preset time units; marks with removed categories are dropped. The interface asks first.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no input.

toggleStepCollapsed.help: Collapses or expands a step card, only through the interface: via the arrow in the card header. Collapsed, the card shows only its header row; the content stays.

params.stepId: The id of the process step.

setSettingsOpen.help: Opens or closes the area with the waste categories and time units, only through the interface: via the toolbar button or the cross in the area.

params.open: True opens the area, false closes it.
